Built to create the sound of from the muddy banks of the Wishkah, this pedal provides pounding tone and vicious attack." It will tear your face off :D Thanks Robert :) Our setup: (pedal, cables: Klotz - AC110, interface: NI KOMPLETE AUDIO 1, ART passive Dibox) I think the "loud" output volume pot was set according to the circumstances. The recording level was around -10 db, normalized to -5 db. We paid close attention to the input level. We used an art di box wired in reverse. We tested it with mikko2, we didn't hear a difference lol. If you have any comments, please let me know in the comments. I hope you enjoy it. Of course we used the pedal AMP output. May metal be with you, peace.
